_comment: FROZEN golden mint attestation, byte-identical to solana/tests/vectors/mint-attestation.json. This is the cross-language parity anchor for the Go signer (signer/internal/attestation/attestation.go), the Rust verifier (solana/crates/attestation) and the TypeScript parity test (solana/tests/attestation-parity.ts). digest is the raw 32-byte keccak digest that secp256k1_recover(digest, signature, recoveryId) must recover `auditor` from (no message-prefixing of any kind is applied). signature is the 64-byte compact r||s form the on-chain syscall consumes -- the recovery byte is carried separately as recoveryId (0 or 1), not appended -- and is canonical low-S, which the on-chain verifier requires. Produced by a fixed, publicly-known test key; never use it for anything real.
